noteCourse.description: The course as it was resolved — the derived code, which may differ from what was asked for.

notePath.description: The note's root-relative path: the same handle note.open takes, so the caller can open what it just created without deriving a path of its own.

noteCreated.description: False when a note of that title already existed for that day and was returned instead of being overwritten. Creating a note never clobbers one.
